params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $relay=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; $origin=(git -C $relay remote get-url origin).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('hcp-prebase-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); git clone --quiet --branch agent/hcp-processes-20260929-0804 --single-branch $origin $tmp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; try { $before=(git -C $tmp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if($before -ne '3551c01404fa1852a07d333486c2d33fb12703aa'){ throw ('branch moved unexpectedly: '+$before) }; git -C $tmp fetch --quiet origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $base=(git -C $tmp rev-parse origin/main).Trim(); git -C $tmp rebase origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $after=(git -C $tmp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); git -C $tmp push --force-with-lease origin HEAD:agent/hcp-processes-20260929-0804; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output ('BEFORE='+$before); Write-Output ('BASE='+$base); Write-Output ('REBASED_SHA='+$after) } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
